The most recent polling data from The Economist and YouGov, taken August 21-28 found that 36 percent of Hispanic voters approved of how Trump is handling his job.

It is a 13-point increase from May 22-26, when 23 percent approved of the president’s job performance, according to polling. It is a further 5-point increase from polling data recorded July 25-27, when 31 percent of Hispanic voters approved of the president.
